name: L no Kisetsu: A Piece of Memories
original_name: Lの季節 A piece of memories
source:
Main character works for school newspaper. One morning a student falls unconscious and after that the number of victims of the strange illness increases. The newspaper staff decide to start own investigation and find out what causes the illness. 

[From [url=https://psxdatacenter.com/games/J/L/SLPS-02203.html]psxdatacenter[/url]]
translation:
主人公在校报社工作。一天早晨，一名学生突然昏倒，此后患上怪病的人越来越多。报社成员决定自行展开调查，查明疾病的成因。

[摘自[url=https://psxdatacenter.com/games/J/L/SLPS-02203.html]Psxdatacenter[/url]]
